slides.title: The Problem with Vague Prompts
content: Vague prompts lead to generic, unhelpful AI responses.
narration: Have you asked an AI a question and received a generic answer?
This often happens because of a weak prompt. Let's see an example of this.
slides.image_prompt: Person at laptop looking confused, AI chatbot giving generic answer. Text: 'Vague Prompts = Vague Answers'.

slides.title: The 3 C's of Great Prompts
content: Clarity: Be specific, avoid ambiguity.
Context: Give background, define audience/role.
Constraints: Set rules for length, format, and tone.
narration: Great prompts include three main elements: Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Clarity means specific requests. Context provides background. Constraints set rules.
These three C's help the AI understand exactly what you need.
They guide the AI to produce more relevant results.
slides.image_prompt: Slide with three prominent icons representing Clarity (magnifying glass), Context (speech bubble with background details), and Constraints (ruler/boundaries).

slides.title: Demonstration: Starting with a Weak Prompt
content: Weak Prompt: "Write about electric cars."
narration: Let's open an AI tool, for example ChatGPT.
Type this weak prompt: 'Write about electric cars.'
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording showing user typing 'Write about electric cars' into ChatGPT, then displaying a generic, broad output.

slides.title: Improvement 1: Adding Clarity
content: Good Prompt (Clear): "Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
narration: Now, let's make our prompt clearer.
We'll specify the format, benefits, and target audience.
Type the following improved prompt into the AI.
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording of user typing improved prompt with Clarity into ChatGPT, showing a more focused blog post output.

slides.title: Improvement 2: Adding Context
content: Better Prompt (with Context): "Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
narration: Next, let's add 'Context'. Who is the audience for this blog post?
Adding 'for a lifestyle blog' gives the AI needed background and perspective.
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording of user typing prompt with added Context into ChatGPT, displaying an output tailored to sustainable living.

slides.title: Improvement 3: Adding Constraints & Persona
content: Excellent Prompt (with Constraints & Persona): "Act as a sustainable living expert. Write a short blog post, under 400 words, for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city. Use a friendly and enthusiastic tone and end with a question to encourage comments."
narration: Finally, let's add 'Constraints' and define a 'Persona' for the AI.
We'll tell the AI to 'Act as a sustainable living expert'.
We also set a word limit, a friendly tone, and a specific ending.
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording of user typing the full, excellent prompt into ChatGPT, showing a highly specific and well-formatted blog post output.

slides.title: Comparing All Outputs
content: From vague to highly targeted: The power of the 3 C's.
narration: Now, look at all four outputs side-by-side.
Observe the weak, clear, contextual, and excellent versions.
See the transformation from a generic paragraph to a targeted blog post.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side comparison of the four AI outputs: weak, clear, contextual, and excellent, highlighting the improvements.

slides.title: Key Takeaways
content: 1. Be specific (Clarity).
2. Give background (Context).
3. Set rules (Constraints).
narration: To summarize, always aim for Clarity in your prompts.
Provide good Context.
And set clear Constraints.
These three simple steps will help you maximize AI tool results.
This makes you more efficient and productive in your work.
slides.image_prompt: Summary slide with bullet points of the 3 C's and their brief descriptions.

slides.title: Assignment
content: Task: Create a 3-day home workout plan.
Step 1: Start with a vague prompt.
Step 2: Refine it by adding Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Step 3: Add a Persona: "Act as a fitness coach."
Compare results and note down the biggest difference.
narration: Here is your assignment. Go to your AI tool, such as ChatGPT or Gemini.
Try to generate a simple 3-day home workout plan for a beginner.
First, try a vague prompt.
Refine it progressively: add Clarity, then Context, and finally Constraints.
Also, ask the AI to 'Act as a fitness coach'.
Compare the results.
Which 'C' or element made the biggest difference? Note your observations.
slides.image_prompt: Assignment slide with instructions for generating a workout plan using progressive prompting.
